recorded_hosted_evidence.provenance: Task-scoped brief and governed show at 2026-11-14; operator read-only observations, not re-probed by this worker.
recorded_hosted_evidence.provided_stack_interpretation: Controller sample proves it is waiting on POST /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled with timeout=30. A separate API sample in config-journal replay during reconciliation is not proof of the cause of that earlier scheduled request timeout.

diagnosis: Exact a9284b68c source uses index.date for run-* trade dates and resets the delivered offset when a later run key appears. The executable candidate benchmark below reproduces the same item/hash prefix on all three recorded keys for each price-history source.
A round-robin least-recently-attempted collector selection places the latest close behind backlog/non-market sources between continuation pulls.

The raw read budget alone does not bound post-read per-item evidence work. Configured newest-session pulls now cap that work at 256 rows while retaining the existing 15-second shared read deadline and four raw readers.

Verified collector native source ids include item identity and hash. Their existing dedupe key can only own that same source id, so a per-row source-dedupe metadata lookup is redundant. Removing it avoids PostgreSQL dedupe scans while retaining normal per-item writes and identity validation; no claim is made that this was the sole hosted 120-second cost.

The final local binding cost is measured from the real controller, configured adapter, scheduler, normalization, raw/normalized persistence, source evidence, receipts and snapshot store plus virtual hosted raw-read latency. The hosted cost outside this model still needs release-coordinator verification.

implementation.trade_date: Maximum validated row trade_date (for a multi-date bundle); additive index/manifest trade_date must agree. Fetch-directory date and dated run ids are candidate upper bounds only, never admitted session identity.
implementation.acknowledgement: Additive latest_priority.json trade_date and items (native item id -> content hash) retain existing source_id/key/delivered/done/held. Save only after native persistence acknowledgement. Migrate old prefixes using their original manifest and held ordering.
implementation.same_session: Retain union of same-session bundle items, latest revision per native id. Do not resend acknowledged id/hash pairs. Re-deliver changed hashes. Keep missing undelivered tail when a new run is smaller, including after restart.
implementation.ordered_sweep: A persisted latest-session identity is not fetched/delivered again by the older ordered sweep. Older revisions cannot overwrite later corrections. Older sessions retain cursor-ordered delivery and partition reuse.
implementation.controller: Pending newest price sessions and due price-source discovery rank before backlog/non-market sources. Retain least-recently-attempted ordering inside each class, normal cadence and failure guards.
unchanged: PIT/provenance/native per-item source and evidence identities
